name: elixir-markdown-preview
description: Browser Markdown preview for Elixir file views. Parser lineage matches deepseek-harness UI (micromark / mdast / GFM).

scripts.build: esbuild entry.mjs --bundle --format=iife --target=es2018 --outfile=../../static/markdown-preview.js --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/*! Elixir Markdown preview. Parser: mdast-util-from-markdown + mdast-util-gfm + micromark-extension-gfm (GFM, singleTilde:false), same family as deepseek-harness dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1 UI. MIT. */"
